quotation_title: LUXURY HONEYMOON IN NORTHERN & CENTRAL VIETNAM
tour_title: Luxury Honeymoon in Northern & Central Vietnam
lede: Celebrate your honeymoon with an unforgettable journey through the most romantic destinations in Northern and Central Vietnam. From the elegant capital of Hanoi to the breathtaking mountain landscapes of Sapa, the peaceful spiritual retreat of Yen Tu, the emerald waters of Halong Bay, and the pristine beaches of Danang, this itinerary combines luxury accommodation, cultural discovery, and unforgettable experiences.
travel_style: Private VIP transfers, private English-speaking guide, all entrance tickets included.
route_txt: Hanoi – Sapa – Yen Tu – Halong Bay – Da Nang – Hanoi
overview_h2: Prepared for: 02 Adults (Honeymoon) — 11 Days | 10 Nights — An Unforgettable Romantic Journey
overview_p:
Celebrate your honeymoon with an unforgettable journey through the most romantic destinations in Northern and Central Vietnam. From the elegant capital of Hanoi to the breathtaking mountain landscapes of Sapa, the peaceful spiritual retreat of Yen Tu, the emerald waters of Halong Bay, and the pristine beaches of Danang, this itinerary combines luxury accommodation, cultural discovery, and unforgettable experiences.

Designed exclusively for couples, the journey offers the perfect balance between sightseeing and relaxation. Stay at Vietnam’s finest luxury hotels, enjoy an overnight cruise in the UNESCO-listed Halong Bay, discover charming ancient towns, and end your honeymoon beside the tranquil waters of West Lake in Hanoi.

landingpageContent.visualDescription: A luxury honeymoon landing page featuring Hanoi, Sapa, Yen Tu, Halong Bay, Danang, and Hoi An.

journeyGlance.mealPreference: Daily Breakfast, Cruise Meals (Lunch, Dinner & Brunch)
journeyGlance.partnerNote: Private VIP transfers, private English-speaking guide, all entrance tickets included.

whyWorks.privateFlexible: Your personal chauffeur and dedicated English-speaking guide are at your exclusive disposal, ensuring your honeymoon moves at an unhurried, intimate pace.
whyWorks.comfort: Rest easy with Vietnam's finest luxury hotels, private transfers, and an exclusive suite experience aboard the Royal Athena Cruise in Halong Bay.
whyWorks.muslimFriendly: All dietary preferences and special romantic touches are pre-arranged seamlessly at every hotel, resort, and cruise throughout your journey.
whyWorks.balancedHighlights: Thoughtfully designed exclusively for couples to balance mountain discovery, spiritual wellness, UNESCO cruising, and pristine beach relaxation.

itinerary.summary: Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, meet your private guide and driver before transferring to Sheraton Hanoi. Enjoy a relaxing afternoon after your international flight. Depending on your arrival time, you may take a leisurely walk around West Lake or enjoy the hotel’s facilities.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private airport transfer, English-speaking guide, Sheraton Hanoi check-in.

itinerary.summary: Breakfast at hotel. Depart for Sapa via the Hanoi – Lao Cai Expressway (approximately 5.5–6 hours). Upon arrival, check in at Hotel de la Coupole MGallery Sapa, one of Vietnam’s most iconic luxury mountain resorts. Free afternoon to relax or explore Sapa town.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private AC transfer via Expressway, Hotel de la Coupole Sapa check-in, guide.

itinerary.summary: Breakfast. Enjoy a guided trek through the spectacular Muong Hoa Valley. Visit: Y Linh Ho Village, Lao Chai Village, Ta Van Village. Meet local ethnic communities while admiring the famous rice terraces. Return to the hotel.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Guided trekking tour, entrance fees to villages, private transport.

itinerary.summary: Breakfast. Private transfer to Yen Tu. Upon arrival, check in at Legacy Yen Tu – MGallery, a luxury wellness retreat inspired by traditional Vietnamese architecture. Spend the afternoon enjoying the peaceful atmosphere or relaxing at the spa.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private transfer Sapa to Yen Tu, Legacy Yen Tu check-in, guide.

itinerary.summary: Breakfast. (Optional) Visit Yen Tu Cable Car before continuing to Halong International Cruise Port. Board the Royal Athena Cruise. Activities include: Welcome Drink, Luxury Lunch, Kayaking, Cave Exploration, Sunset Party, Vietnamese Cooking Demonstration. Dinner onboard.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private transfer, Royal Athena Cruise tickets & cabin, onboard activities, kayaking, cave entrance, welcome drink, lunch, dinner.

itinerary.summary: Early Tai Chi session. Breakfast onboard. Continue cruising through Halong Bay. Brunch before disembarkation. Transfer to Novotel Halong Bay. Free afternoon to relax by the beach or swimming pool.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Tai Chi session, morning cruise, disembarkation transfer to Novotel Halong Bay.

itinerary.summary: Breakfast. Transfer to Noi Bai Airport. Domestic flight to Danang. Arrival and transfer to InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort. Enjoy the remainder of the day at leisure.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private airport transfer, domestic flight to Danang, resort arrival transfer.

itinerary.summary: Breakfast. Private excursion to Ba Na Hills. Highlights include: Golden Bridge, World’s Longest Cable Car, French Village, Fantasy Park, Le Jardin D’Amour. Return to resort.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private Ba Na Hills excursion, cable car tickets, entrance fees, guide.

itinerary.summary: Breakfast. Transfer to Cam Thanh Coconut Village. Experience: Traditional Basket Boat Ride, Coconut Forest. Continue to Hoi An Ancient Town. Walking tour includes: Japanese Covered Bridge, Ancient Houses, Lantern Streets, Local Market. Free time for shopping and cafés before returning to Danang.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Basket boat experience, Cam Thanh coconut forest, Hoi An walking tour tickets, guide, transfers.

itinerary.summary: Breakfast. Transfer to Danang Airport for your domestic flight. Arrival in Hanoi. Transfer to InterContinental Hanoi Westlake. Located on the tranquil waters of West Lake, the hotel provides a peaceful and romantic atmosphere—an ideal setting to conclude your honeymoon. Spend your final evening enjoying the stunning sunset at Sunset Bar or indulge in a romantic dinner overlooking the lake.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Airport transfers, domestic flight Danang - Hanoi, InterContinental Hanoi Westlake check-in.

itinerary.summary: Breakfast. Private transfer to Noi Bai International Airport for your departure flight. End of Services.

edited_fields.tour_title: Luxury Honeymoon in Northern & Central Vietnam
edited_fields.lede: Celebrate your honeymoon with an unforgettable journey through the most romantic destinations in Northern and Central Vietnam. From the elegant capital of Hanoi to the breathtaking mountain landscapes of Sapa, the peaceful spiritual retreat of Yen Tu, the emerald waters of Halong Bay, and the pristine beaches of Danang, this itinerary combines luxury accommodation, cultural discovery, and unforgettable experiences.
edited_fields.journey_overview_title: A Journey Shaped Around Your Family
edited_fields.letter_highlight: This journey was designed to leave room for both discovery and rest.
edited_fields.letter_intro: I am delighted to present this privately arranged journey created for 02 Adults (Honeymoon) travelling from 25 Aug – 04 Sep 2026. The route unfolds from Hanoi – Sapa – Yen Tu – Halong Bay – Da Nang – Hanoi.
edited_fields.letter_body_p2: We have poured our expertise and passion into crafting every detail of this journey, and we cannot wait for you to experience the magic of Vietnam.
edited_fields.letter_outro: Please review the journey as a starting point for a personal conversation. Every final detail can be refined around your preferred pace, room choices and family priorities.
